definitions.explanation: not yet having been dealt with, processed, or treated

examples.japanese: {未処理|みしょり}の{書類|しょるい}がたまっている。
{未処理|みしょり}の{排水|はいすい}を{川|かわ}に{流|なが}してはいけない。
examples.english: You must not discharge untreated wastewater into the river.

examples.japanese: {未処理|みしょり}の{案件|あんけん}が{三十件|さんじゅっけん}も{残|のこ}っているので、{今日中|きょうじゅう}に{片付|かたづ}けたい。
examples.english: There are thirty unresolved cases remaining, so I want to get them done by today.

notes:
Composed of {未|み} (not yet) + {処理|しょり} (processing, treatment). The prefix {未|み} is productive and indicates something has not yet been done: {未完成|みかんせい} (unfinished), {未確認|みかくにん} (unconfirmed), {未解決|みかいけつ} (unsolved).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {未処理|みしょり}の{書類|しょるい}: unprocessed documents
- {未処理|みしょり}のデータ: raw/unprocessed data
- {未処理|みしょり}{排水|はいすい}: untreated wastewater
- {未処理|みしょり}{案件|あんけん}: unresolved cases
- {未処理|みしょり}のまま{放置|ほうち}する: to leave unprocessed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未解決|みかいけつ}: unsolved, unresolved — specifically for problems or cases that haven't been solved
- {処理済|しょりず}み: processed, handled — the opposite state, indicating completion
- {保留|ほりゅう}: pending, on hold — deliberately put aside for later decision
